summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, announcing its total voting rights and share capital as of June 30, 2026. The filing states the issued ordinary share capital (16,486,312,994 shares, par value US$0.25) and preference shares (12,706,252 shares, par value £1), with total voting rights of 15,707,981,865. This is a routine regulatory disclosure under UK FCA rules, not a special situation. No transaction, event, or corporate action affecting shareholders is described. The filing merely provides shareholder notification thresholds for DGTR compliance.
